# Laravel Chile

> Thoughtful tools for Chilean applications. Documentation for geolize-studio/laravel-chile 0.1.0.

Install the `0.1` release line with `composer require "geolize-studio/laravel-chile:^0.1"`. Domain pages document actual APIs. Read docs/verification.md for executed checks. During `0.x`, minor releases may change APIs; inspect the installed version and changelog before integrating.

This is an optional navigation index, available in the repository and distribution. Inclusion here does not imply search indexing or agent recommendation.

## Project

- [Packagist](https://packagist.org/packages/geolize-studio/laravel-chile): Package versions and Composer metadata.
- [README](README.md): Installation, implemented scope, and documentation entry point.
- [Contributor guidance](AGENTS.md): Repository conventions and verification boundaries.
- [Developer experience](docs/developer-experience.md): API and integration design principles.

## Domain contracts

- [RUT](docs/rut.md): Parsing, checksum validation, storage, and identity limitations.
- [Territory](docs/territory.md): Official CUT sources, hierarchy, ambiguity, and source-update review.
- [Territory enums](docs/enums.md): Native enum values, relationships, and filtered options.
- [Eloquent integration](docs/eloquent.md): Model casts, storage schemas, nulls, and serialization.
- [CLP and IVA](docs/money.md): Exact amounts, rational rates, rounding, and overflow.

## Agent integration

- [Consumer skill](resources/boost/skills/chile-development/SKILL.md): Version-aware guidance for using or developing the package.
- [Boost guideline](resources/boost/guidelines/core.blade.php): Concise domain constraints.
- [Discovery and adoption](docs/discoverability.md): Supported discovery channels, experimental navigation, and evaluation.
- [Release checklist](docs/release-checklist.md): Evidence required before advertising or publishing functionality.
